full_judgment: 3. The suit pathway measures .08 decimal of land and appertains to dag No. 10317 of khatian No. 1703 within J.L. No. 91 under Sylhet Municipality. It is within the Rajbari belonging to the predecessor-in-interest of Sree Kumar Gourish Chandra Roy and the defendant No. 1, Remendra Kumar Dutta Chowdhury. It is said to run on contiguous south and south east of the plaintiffs homestead land which he got by purchase from the defendant No. 5 Abdul Jalil who in his turn purchased from Kumar Gourish Chandra Roy. The plaintiff alleged that the suit land was used by Sree Kumar Gourish Chandra Roy and the defendant No. 1 from the time of their predecessors as the only linking pathway linking their homestead with Roynagar Municipal Road. The suit pathway is a curved pathway on the south and cast of the plot No. 10316 which is plaintiffs homestead and also the plot No. 10319. Kumar Gourish sold by kabala dated 3.7.67 to defendant No. 5 Abdul Jalil .25 decimal of land out of plot Nos. 10316 and 10319. Plaintiff purchased from defendant No. 2.25 decimal of land out of plot No. 10316 by kabala dated 20.11.70 and since then he is using the suit path- way which lies to the south west of his purchased land as the only link from his homestead to Municipal Road. During last settlement operation the land was wrongly recorded in the name of defendant No. 1. Taking advantage of the wrong record the defendant No. 1 sold .03 decimal of land to defendant No. 2 out of the suit pathway. Defendant No. 2 is now obstructing the pathway by making various constructions giving rise to the cause of action for the suit.
